reuse.why: setLastMonthSpending and the averages go through getBulkBudgetCategories, but setZero keeps its own copy of that query instead of being switched to the helper, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own JS filter.

duplication.why: The same hidden-category conditional is written three times: in getBulkBudgetCategories, in setZero's inline SQL (a copy of the helper query) and in copyPreviousMonth's filter.

placement.why: All edits sit in budget/actions.ts where the selection logic lives, but the flag is applied at the action level rather than in one selection layer.

scope.why: Focused on the flag; the reshaping of set3/6/12MonthAvg to an options type is a small related tidy-up.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule now has three independently maintained switches, so the next change to category selection must again be made in three places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero in budget/actions.ts runs its own copy of the getBulkBudgetCategories SQL (patched with the same conditional) instead of calling the helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The setZero query and copyPreviousMonth filter are visible parallel copies, not reshaped ones.
